name: tap2chef-e2e
description: Browser scripts: run the dev server on :5199 (cd client && npx vite --port 5199), then node day.mjs | node bill2.mjs <name> <w> <h> <light|dark> | node menu.mjs <name> <w> <h> <light|dark>. Sign-in: start the API on a throwaway database (cd server && npm run dev:memory > /tmp/api.log), then node account.mjs /tmp/api.log and node sync.mjs /tmp/api.log (two devices, one restaurant). Screenshots land in e2e/shots (git-ignored); read every one.
